page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Laborierius" (printed Laborierius, name as set), "credétium" (tilde over e as printed), "imperu" (as printed, possibly a misprint for imperio). The printed mark "V.à Geneua." at top left is in the margin and is recorded as a note. The long s is plain s throughout; i/j and u/v are normalised. No page number or signature is printed.
